description_en: Queries the storage overview information of an AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster, such as the total data size, hot data size, cold data size, and data growth
description_zh: 查看实例的空间概览信息，包括总数据量、热数据量、冷数据量、数据增长量等
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-cluster-space-summary --db-cluster-id am-bp1u8c0mgfg580000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterSpaceSummary

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看数仓版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

DataSize.description_en: The data size of table records. Unit: bytes

IndexSize.description_en: The data size of regular indexes. Unit: bytes

OtherSize.description_en: The other data size. Unit: bytes

PrimaryKeyIndexSize.description_en: The data size of primary key indexes. Unit: bytes

TotalSize.description_en:
The cold data size. Unit: bytes.

Formula: Cold data size = Data size of table records + Data size of regular indexes + Data size of primary key indexes + Other data size
TotalSize.description_zh:
冷数据总量，单位：Byte。

计算公式为：冷数据总量 = 表记录数据量 + 普通索引数据量 + 主键索引数据量 + 其他

DayGrowth.description_en:
The data growth within the last day. Unit: bytes.

Formula: Data growth within the last day = Current data size - Data size of one day ago
DayGrowth.description_zh:
近1天增长量，单位：Byte。

计算公式为：近1天增长量 = 当前总数据量 - 1天前总数据量

WeekGrowth.description_en:
The daily data growth within the last seven days. Unit: bytes.

Formula: Daily data growth within the last seven days = (Current data size - Data size of seven days ago)/7
WeekGrowth.description_zh:
近7天日均增长量，单位：Byte。

计算公式为：近7天日均增长量 = (当前总数据量 - 7天前总数据量) / 7

DataSize.description_en: The data size of table records. Unit: bytes

IndexSize.description_en: The data size of regular indexes. Unit: bytes

OtherSize.description_en: The other data size. Unit: bytes

PrimaryKeyIndexSize.description_en: The data size of primary key indexes. Unit: bytes

TotalSize.description_en:
The hot data size. Unit: bytes.

Formula: Hot data size = Data size of table records + Data size of regular indexes + Data size of primary key indexes + Other data size
TotalSize.description_zh:
热数据总量，单位：Byte。

计算公式为：热数据总量 = 表记录数据量 + 普通索引数据量 + 主键索引数据量 + 其他

TotalSize.description_en:
The total data size. Unit: bytes.

Formula: Total data size = Hot data size+ Cold data size
TotalSize.description_zh:
总数据量，单位：Byte。

计算公式为：总数据量 = 热数据总量 + 冷数据总量
